notes.title: UI Update
notes.content: Added UI settings for changing card deck visuals or the game background image.

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content: Bug related to scoring should be fixed now.

notes.title: New Trailer
notes.content: The store page now displays a more up-to-date trailer. The previous clip was wrongly showing an old version. A nice thing about the new trailer is that it gives a decent summary of what one (currently) can expect from this game.

notes.title: Bugfix
notes.content: Small fix so that you can play non-standard trump-variations.

notes.title: Feature Update
notes.content:
This update brings a lot of new features that will make the multiplayer experience a lot smoother. The AI might be improved in a future update, which still requires more work.

Some new features are:
[list]
[*] Admin seats in the lobby page
[*] Undo-redo
[*] Save-load
[*] Replay games
[*] Score settings
[*] Preview trump cards
[*] Language settings
[/list]

notes.title: Planned Updates
notes.content:
While it has been a while without updates there are future improvements in the works. The plan is to come up with a better version of the game. 

The next version of the game should have: 
-Improved UI
-UI customizability
-Different AI modes
-Save/Load multiplayer games
-Replayability - set "seed" for games or randomize seed
-Undo/Redo
-Translations to other languages than English

To connect with the developer (me) join the official Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/Q26Hh2W2Mj]here[/url].

notes.title: AI Patch
notes.content: The AI has been trained via a genetic algorithm to be better than before.

notes.title: Mega Patch 2022
notes.content:
Changes
[list]
[*] Better visuals
[*] More gamemodes
[*] Different AI
[*] More robust multiplayer
[/list]
